name: Agent session document
description: The document that anchors one session (thread) with an agent. Session messages are ordinary Hypermedia Comments (see agent-message) targeting this document, so the whole conversation is permanent, signed, threaded network data. A sub-session is another session document whose parentSession points here. Ephemeral state (streaming output, in-flight tool calls) never appears on the network; derived state like a status flag is computed by readers, not stored.

agent.description: The agent this session converses with.

parentSession.description: For a sub-session: the session document this one was delegated from.
